FC Fakel Voronezh is a Russian professional football club based in Voronezh. Founded in 1947, the club has played in the Soviet Top League and the Russian Premier League. The club will return to the Russian Premier League in the 2026–27 season. The club holds the record for fan attendance in Eastern Europe.
